Name: Along the Way - Immersive Fast Travel and Journey System
Author: acharles1
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Along the Way[/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]A cozy fast travel system where you skipped the walk - not the journey.[/i][/center]
[center][i]Every journey has a destination.
But along the way, we travel, we discover, we meet people, and we make little memories.
Sometimes the journey matters just as much as where we end up.[/i][/center]

[center]That’s Along the Way...[/center]
[center]Time passes. The road still matters. Sometimes something happens along the way, and sometimes it’s simply a quiet trip from one place to another. It imagines what might have happened while your farmer was getting there.[/center]
[center]You still get the convenience of fast travel, but the journey never feels completely lost.[/center]



🗺️ [b]WHAT IS ALONG THE WAY?[/b]
Along the Way is an immersive fast travel system built around one simple idea:
[b]You skipped the walk - not the journey.[/b]
Instead of instantly moving your farmer from one location to another, the mod works out the journey, lets the appropriate amount of in-game time pass, simulates what may have happened along the way, and then brings you to your destination.

Some journeys are peaceful.
Some are lucky.
Some are inconvenient.
Some are strange.
And sometimes absolutely nothing happens.
That’s part of traveling too.


📬 [b]HOW TO START[/b]
Along the Way becomes available as you make some progress in the valley.
Once you have:
• Unlocked the Mines
• Repaired the bridge at the Beach

Keep an eye on your mailbox. The Traveling Merchant has something for you.

From there, you’ll be able to craft the Travel Kit, start marking Places, and begin filling your Journal with the parts of the valley that matter to you.


📍 [b]CREATE YOUR OWN TRAVEL POINTS[/b]
Along the Way doesn’t decide where your fast travel points should be. You do.

Use the [b]Travel Kit[/b] to mark a location you want to return to.
Choose a name and a little chalk X will remain there as your travel marker.

Your saved locations are then added to the Travel Journal.
You can:
[list]
[*]Create as many travel points as you want[/*]
[*]Name them yourself[/*]
[*]Rename them later[/*]
[*]Favorite important destinations[/*]
[*]Search through your saved locations[/*]
[*]Remove markers you no longer need[/*]
[/list]By default, travel points are intended for outdoor locations, with additional placement options available through the settings.


📖 [b]THE TRAVEL JOURNAL[/b]
Your journeys are managed through a custom Travel Journal.
The Journal keeps your saved [b]Places[/b] and unlocked [b]People[/b] together while still making the trip feel like part of Stardew Valley.
Before travelling, you can see your destination and estimated journey time.
Once you leave, the Journal becomes your little record of what happened along the way.


⏰ [b]TRAVEL TAKES TIME[/b]
Along the Way is fast travel, but it isn’t free teleportation.
Journeys take time.
A short trip takes less.
A longer trip takes more.
The idea is to keep travelling convenient without making distance stop mattering completely.
If you want the pacing a little faster or slower, the travel-time multiplier can be adjusted in the settings.


🌿 [b]THINGS HAPPEN ALONG THE WAY[/b]
Not every journey is identical.
While travelling, your farmer may experience little moments from several encounter types:
[list]
[*]Social[/*]
[*]Discovery[/*]
[*]Lucky[/*]
[*]Mishap[/*]
[*]Delay[/*]
[*]Environment[/*]
[*]Kindness[/*]
[*]Rare / Special[/*]
[/list]You might notice something beside the road.
You might lose a little time.
You might get lucky.
You might cross paths with someone.
You might see something you weren’t expecting.
Or you might simply have a quiet walk.
Along the Way contains a large pool of different journey narratives with repeat avoidance so traveling throughout a longer save doesn’t mean reading the exact same few stories again and again.


👥 [b]TRAVEL TO PEOPLE[/b]
Once you become close enough with someone, they can become available through the [b]People[/b] side of the Travel Journal.
Choose them and Along the Way will work out where they are when you arrive.
If they move while you’re travelling, the mod checks again before bringing you there.

The default friendship requirement is [b]5 hearts[/b], and it can be adjusted through the settings.


⚙️ [b]CONFIGURATION[/b]
Along the Way includes settings for things such as:
[list]
[*]Travel time multiplier[/*]
[*]Journey encounters[/*]
[*]People friendship requirement[/*]
[*]Travel-marker placement rules[/*]
[*]HUD position and size[/*]
[/list]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional if you want to adjust these easily in-game.


❤️ [b]WHY I MADE ALONG THE WAY[/b]
I love the convenience of fast travel.
But I’ve always felt like there is something strange about disappearing and instantly appearing somewhere else.
That was really where Along the Way started.
I like the idea that when my farmer leaves home in the morning and ends up somewhere else later, there was still a journey between those two moments.
Maybe it was boring.
Maybe something funny happened.
Maybe they got caught in the rain.
Maybe they stopped for a second.
Maybe they saw something they’ll probably never see again.
I don’t need to play every step of that walk.
I just like knowing it happened.
That became the whole feeling behind this mod.
The walk can be skipped.
The journey doesn’t have to be.
[b]You skip the walk - not the journey.[/b]



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu - Optional[/*]
[/list]
💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Along the Way is a [b]standalone mod[/b] and does not require, bundle, modify, redistribute, or depend on any specific third-party mod or its content to function.
It works through Stardew Valley’s normal runtime information for locations, NPCs, friendship, time, maps and warps. If additional content is present in the game and exposes that information normally, Along the Way may be able to interact with it through those same game systems.
That does [b]not[/b] make any other mod a requirement or dependency of Along the Way, and no third-party assets, dialogue, code or authored content are included with this mod.
Because different setups can structure locations and schedules in different ways, I can’t guarantee every possible setup will behave perfectly. If something behaves strangely, feel free to report it.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development, including coding assistance and production of some final visual assets from designs and visual direction created and approved by me.
Along the Way was designed, directed, tested, balanced and approved by me.
The released mod does [b]not[/b] use AI, an LLM, or another generative system while Stardew Valley is running. Travel calculations, encounters, narrative selection, NPC finding, time progression and other gameplay systems use programmed rules and predefined content included with the mod.
Along the Way also does not generate dialogue, artwork, personalities or other new content for third-party mods at runtime.
